description: This file contains the implementation of a gross profit report in ERPNext, including data fetching, processing, and grouping logic for sales invoice items, stock ledger entries, and product bundles.

classes.name: GrossProfitGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating gross profit data, including loading invoice items, stock ledger entries, product bundles, and calculating gross profit metrics.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns and data for the gross profit report based on filters.

methods.name: get_data_when_grouped_by_invoice
methods.description: Prepares report data when grouping is by invoice.

methods.name: get_data_when_not_grouped_by_invoice
methods.description: Prepares report data when not grouping by invoice.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns based on grouping and filters.

methods.name: get_column_names
methods.description: Returns a mapping of internal column identifiers to display names.
